title: Horratic
description: A story-driven psychological horror mod about what it feels like when things get bad. Eight stages. A journal. Letters you never sent. Two endings. This one is meant to be felt.
body:
This mod is meant to be a standalone experience. Not recommended to add to horror modpacks. It is a story based on real life emotions people experience. This mod is not meant for the faint of heart. It speaks heavily on feelings of being deppressed. If you or a loved one are suffering please speak up. You are worth it!

Horratic is a story-driven psychological horror mod built around one question: what does it actually feel like when things get bad?

You play through eight stages — Denial, Intrusion, Descent, Defiance, Unraveling, Despair, Revelation, and finally a choice. The horror isn't about casual jump scares. It's a journal that writes itself as you fall apart. It's a book of letters you started but never sent. It's a reflection of yourself that knows everything about you.

The Willpower system tracks how you're doing. It drops in the dark, under pressure, when you're hungry and alone. It recovers through light, rest, food, and the things that actually help. Gold is your best friend — but something else likes gold too...

Content Warning

This mod contains themes of depression, isolation, emotional withdrawal, and the experience of not being able to ask for help. It is an allegory, not a clinical portrayal — but it draws from real feelings and is intended to be felt, not just survived.

This is a serious topic and is portrayed heavily in this mod. It is meant to be an emotional horror focusing  on real world problems. If this topic offends you, please avoid this mod.

This mod contains:

Weapons/Tools/Armor/Amulet
Horror/Jumpscares/Psychological
Story-Driven
Dweller-like entities
Scary Maze Game
Fully Customizable
Emotional Damage
Boss


 

Two endings. Permanent consequences. Post-ending buffs.

Highly configurable. In active development.
